title: youtube-redirect-player
subtitle: YouTube Video Player with WebSocket
description: A Flask + Socket.IO player with request, default and history playlists synchronised across screens. New development continues in Streaming Player.
longDescription: The Flask player synchronises a request queue, default playlist and playback history over Socket.IO. Its final version resolves media with yt-dlp and includes Docker and regression tests. The Rust + React Streaming Player carries on the song-request workflow.
features: yt-dlp media resolution and Docker deployment
results: Final Flask version preserved; song requests continue in Streaming Player
